A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose an integrated model to jointly model the topics covered by an event and tweets about the event, as well as to segment the tweets into segments that are associated with the event.
we propose a joint Bayesian model for aligning event and its Twitter feedback, and we demonstrate that our model is able to improve the quality of event segmentation and topic modeling.
we propose a novel joint Bayesian model for topic modeling and event alignment, and demonstrate that it outperforms baseline models on two large-scale datasets from different domains.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the joint modeling of topics and events is beneficial for both tasks.
event topic modeling and segmentation can benefit from each other and should not be studied separately.
the joint topic modeling of event and tweets is a promising approach to understanding events in social media.
